ValidationRule.description: Prevents submission/review/approval without core customer, vehicle, and payment fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Under Review"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Final Review"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Released") ), OR( ISBLANK(Borrower_First_Name__c), ISBLANK(Borrower_Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(Borrower_Mobile_Number__c), ISPICKVAL(Applicant_Type__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Payment_Option__c, ""), ISBLANK(Selected_Vehicle__c), ISBLANK(Vehicle_Price_PHP__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before submitting, complete borrower name/mobile, applicant type, payment option, selected vehicle, and vehicle price.
